mapper.select:
select `supplierinfo`.*, `customerinfo`.`customer_name` as supplierContact, `customerinfo`.`customer_phone` as supplierPhone from `supplierinfo` left join `customerinfo` on `supplierinfo`.`customerinfo_id` = `customerinfo`.id
and `supplierinfo`.`supplier_name` like concat ('%', #{supplierName}, '%')
and `customerinfo`.`customer_name` like concat ('%', #{supplierContact}, '%')
